## Matched PolyA/RiboD - DIPG-IV

```{r library}
library(tidyverse)
library(GGally)

```

### Correlogram (Fig A)

```{r THR13_expr_filter_zero_variance}
THR13_log2TPM1_matrix <- read_tsv("../output_data/THR13_0970_S12-S17/THR13_log2TPM1_matrix.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  as.matrix()

THR13_expr_filter_zero_variance <- read_tsv("../output_data/THR13_0970_S12-S17/THR13_expr_filter_zero_variance.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE)
# this data has variance filter that removed lowly expressed and invariable genes
```

```{r THR13_expr_filter_zero_variance format}
# integrate density plot with coefficient value and color by coefficient value

cor_color_fn2 <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  corr <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$x) %>%
    cor(eval_data_col(data, mapping$y), method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  ggally_cor(data, mapping, method = "spearman", colour = I("black")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = scales::col_numeric(c("#ec944d", "white", "#084c8b"), c(0.9,1))(corr)
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank())
}

# function for diagonal density
diag_filtered_density <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  # Pull out just the column being plotted on this diagonal panel
  x <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  
  # Keep only expressed genes (log2TPM > 0)
  x_filtered <- x[x > 0]
  
  ggplot(data.frame(x = x_filtered), aes(x = x)) +
    geom_density(fill = "grey70", color = "black") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

plot_df <- THR13_expr_filter_zero_variance %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(PolyA_1, PolyA_2, PolyA_3, RiboD_1, RiboD_2, RiboD_3)

global_min <- min(plot_df, na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(plot_df, na.rm = TRUE)

# function for scatterplot with fixed axes
scatter_fixed_axes <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data, mapping) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
    xlim(global_min, global_max) +
    ylim(global_min, global_max) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", color = "green4") # with y=x slope intercept line
}
```

```{r THR13_expr_filter_zero_variance_plot}
THR13_expr_filter_zero_variance_plot <- ggpairs(
  plot_df,
  columns = 1:6,
  lower = list(continuous = wrap(scatter_fixed_axes)),
  upper = list(continuous = wrap(cor_color_fn2, method = "spearman")),
  diag  = list(continuous = wrap(diag_filtered_density))
) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 9),
    strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, size = 9),
    panel.grid   = element_blank()
  )
THR13_expr_filter_zero_variance_plot
```

```{r fig b files}
THR13_all_expr_bins <- read_tsv("../output_data/THR13_0970_S12-S17/THR13_all_expr_bins.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%

  mutate(ExprBin = factor(ExprBin, levels = c("0", "0-0.09", "0.1-0.99", "1-2.99", "3-4.99", ">5"))) %>%
  mutate(

    full_sample == "THR13_0970_S12" ~ "PolyA_1",

    full_sample == "THR13_0970_S15" ~ "RiboD_1",

  ))
```

```{r}
theme_b <- function(base_size = 14) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size * 0.9),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size * 1.1, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, size = 16), 
      axis.title.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 17), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 10, 10)
    )
}

scale_fill_compendia <- function() {
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "riboD" = "#E69F00",  # yellow
    "polyA" = "#0072B2"   # blue
  ))
}
scale_color_compendia <- function() {
  scale_color_manual(values = c( 
    "riboD" = "#E69F00", 
    "polyA" = "#0072B2" ))
}

```

```{r b_prop_plot}
# Get unique THIDs
samplesB <- unique(THR13_bin_prop_libprep$full_sample)

# Generate one plot per sample
b_prop_plot <- map(samplesB, function(d) {
  
  dfB <- THR13_bin_prop_libprep %>% filter(full_sample == d)
  
  ggplot(dfB, aes(x = full_sample, y = Proportion, fill = ExprBin)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(
      option = "D", 
      name = expression(atop("Expression", "in log"[2]*"(TPM+1)"))
      ) +
    labs(
      # title = paste(d),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Proportion of Genes",
      fill = "Expression Level"
    ) +
    theme_b() +
      theme(
        strip.text = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank()
      )
})

# Name the plots by THIDs
names(b_prop_plot) <- samplesB
b_prop_plot
```

```{r combined_prop_plot}
prop_plot_names <- names(b_prop_plot)
n <- length(prop_plot_names)
ncols <- 6
bottom_row <- prop_plot_names[seq(from = ceiling(n / ncols) * ncols - ncols + 1, to = n)]


b_plots_subset <- imap(b_prop_plot[prop_plot_names], function(p, name) {
  if (!name %in% bottom_row) {
    # hide x-axis on all panels except the last
    p + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  } else {
    # show x-axis only on the last panel
    p + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  }
})

b_combined_prop_plot <- wrap_plots(b_plots_subset, ncol = 6) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect", axes = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(legend.position = "right")
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2, l = 4, r = 4),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.35, face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )

b_combined_prop_plot
```

```{r theme_c}
theme_c <- function(base_size = 14) {

      axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 17),

```

```{r facet_labels_c}
facet_labels_c <- c(
  "0" = "x = 0",
  "0-0.09" = "0 > x > 0.1",
  "0.1-0.99" = "0.1 > x > 1",
  "1-2.99" = "1 > x > 3",
  "3-4.99" = "3 > x > 5",
  ">5" = "x > 5"
)

max_y <- max(THR13_combined_counts$Count, na.rm = TRUE)

#y-position for stars
y_star <- max(THR13_combined_counts$Count, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
```

```{r bin_order}
bin_order <- c("0", "0-0.09", "0.1-0.99", "1-2.99", "3-4.99", ">5")

THR13_combined_counts <- THR13_combined_counts %>%
  mutate(Bin = factor(Bin, levels = bin_order))

stat_df <- THR13_combined_counts %>%
  group_by(Bin) %>%
  arrange(full_sample, .by_group = TRUE) %>%   # ensures pairs line up
  t_test(Count ~ lib_prep, var.equal = FALSE) %>% # welch's t-test
  adjust_pvalue(method = "holm") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")
stat_df

```

```{r sig_df}
sig_df_c <- stat_df %>%
  mutate(
    y_star = max_y * 1.05,
    stars_adj = p.adj.signif
  )
```

```{r unique_genes_plot}
unique_genes_plot <- ggplot(THR13_combined_counts, aes(x = lib_prep, y = Count, color = lib_prep)) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    dodge.width = 0.85,
    width = 0.4,
    alpha = .8,
    size = 2
  ) +
  # adding stars above text
  geom_text(
    data = sig_df_c,
    aes(x = 1.5, y = y_star, label = stars_adj),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 6
  ) +
  
  facet_grid(. ~ Bin, labeller = labeller(Bin = facet_labels_c)) +
  scale_fill_compendia() +
  scale_color_compendia() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_comma(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k")
    ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_star)) +
  labs(
    # title = paste("DIPG-IV Matched PolyA/RiboD datasets"),
    x = "log2(TPM+1) = x",
    y = "Gene count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_c() +
  theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      # strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(t = -2)
    )

unique_genes_plot
```

```{r}
# median ratio for HIST1H1B = 0.08042886
```

### Scatterplot of median expression (Fig F)

```{r THR13_gene_medians_res}
THR13_gene_medians_res <- read_tsv("../output_data/THR13_0970_S12-S17/THR13_gene_medians_res.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r THR13_gene_medians_res format}
# representative polyadenylated genes were found in THR13_0970_S12-S17/THR13_0970_S12-S17_rep_genes.md, calculated as the median expression level in PolyA samples divided by the median expression level in RiboD samples

THR13_gene_medians_res <- THR13_gene_medians_res %>%
  mutate(
    label_color = case_when(
    ensembl_gene_ID == "ENSG00000165609.12" ~ "#0072B2", #NUDT5
    ensembl_gene_ID == "ENSG00000184357.4" ~ "#E69F00", #HIST1H1B
    TRUE ~ "grey70"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      ensembl_gene_ID == "ENSG00000165609.12" ~ HugoID.x,
      ensembl_gene_ID == "ENSG00000184357.4" ~ HugoID.x, # HIST1H1B + median ratio gene
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r med_scatterplot}
med_scatterplot <- ggplot(THR13_gene_medians_res, aes(x = THR13_polyA_median, y = THR13_riboD_median)) +
  geom_point(data = THR13_gene_medians_res %>% filter(is.na(label)),
             color = "grey70", alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = THR13_gene_medians_res %>% filter(!is.na(label)),
             aes(color = label_color),
             size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 4.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +   # use colors exactly as defined
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    xlab(bquote(Median~PolyA~log[2](TPM+1))) +
    ylab(bquote(Median~RiboD~log[2](TPM+1))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    plot_theme_f()
```

### Expression of TH druggable genes (Fig G)

```{r THR13_drug_form}
THR13_drug_form <- read_tsv("../output_data/THR13_0970_S12-S17/THR13_drug_form.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r THR13_drug_genes_plot}
THR13_drug_form_df <- THR13_drug_form %>%
  filter(!is.na(HugoID)) %>%
  mutate(gene_key = paste(ensembl_gene_ID, HugoID, sep = "|"))

# order keys by median expression (one value per key)
gene_order <- THR13_drug_form_df %>%
  group_by(gene_key) %>%
  summarize(ord = median(median_expr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(ord) %>%
  pull(gene_key)

THR13_drug_form_df <- THR13_drug_form_df %>% 
  mutate(gene_key = factor(gene_key, levels = gene_order)) %>%
  mutate(lib_prep = case_when(
    grepl("polya", lib_prep, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "polyA",
    grepl("ribod", lib_prep, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "riboD",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_))

# lookup: key -> HugoID
label_lookup <- THR13_drug_form_df %>%
  distinct(gene_key, HugoID) %>%
  { setNames(as.character(.$HugoID), as.character(.$gene_key)) }

THR13_drug_genes_plot <- ggplot(THR13_drug_form_df, aes(x = gene_key, y = median_expr, color = lib_prep)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.numeric(gene_key)), color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = label_lookup,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 11), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_color_compendia() +
  labs(x = NULL, color = "Library Prep") +
  ylab(bquote(Median~log[2](TPM+1))) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, size = 15),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.margin = margin(t = -2)
  )
THR13_drug_genes_plot
```

```{r}
  plot_layout(design = design, 
              heights = c(6, 4, 4, 4)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))
```
